detail: Diagnosed as missing from the registered set; a bounded local search found no reusable candidate (no capability_library CLI, no globally installed npm digest package, no Python module, and no in-tree procedure for observation digesting), so a dependency-free Node procedure was authored under the mission artifact directory. It reads input/pilot.observations.json, validates each row (site is a non-empty string; scheduled/completed/incidents are non-negative integers; completed <= scheduled), sums exact integer totals overall and per site, cross-checks that site totals reconcile to the overall totals, and computes completion_percent to 2 decimals with integer basis-point half-up arithmetic floor((completed*10000*2 + scheduled)/(2*scheduled))/100 rather than floating point. It persists digest.json and digest.md from the same computed values plus a receipt.json. Qualification is static, not from execution: node --check passes, the source sha256 was re-read from disk and matches, the two-argument arity guard is present, no network/package imports exist, and the rounding formula agreed with an independent Python Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP recomputation on 14 cases with zero mismatches; the same independent recomputation of the fixture fixed the expected values at row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, North 22/18/5 and South 8/8/1. The proposed target was deliberately not executed during acquisition. No packages, network, publishing, deployment, purchases or external changes were made; all writes stayed inside the mission artifact directory.
